description: RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over literal with single argument registers an offense and corrects unsuitable use of dig
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over literal with single argument does not register an offense unsuitable use of dig with safe navigation operator
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over literal with multiple arguments does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over literal when using dig with splat operator does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig >= Ruby 2.7 when using dig with arguments forwarding does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig >= Ruby 3.1 when using dig with anonymous block argument forwarding does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig Ruby <= 3.2 when using dig with anonymous rest argument forwarding does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig Ruby <= 3.2 when using dig with anonymous keyword argument forwarding does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over a variable as caller with single argument registers an offense and corrects unsuitable use of dig
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over a variable as caller with multiple arguments does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over a variable as caller when using multiple `dig` in a method chain registers and corrects an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig dig over a variable as caller when using dig with splat operator does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig when without a receiver does not register an offense
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig when there is a chain of digs and `Style/DigChain` is enabled does not register an offense for chained `dig` calls
RuboCop::Cop::Style::SingleArgumentDig when there is a chain of digs and `Style/DigChain` is not enabled does registers an offense for chained `dig` calls
